hooks.name: Guard terms and contact data on stop
hooks.description: When the agent stops, scan files changed this session for forbidden claim terms and contact data, then append one summary line to KIRO_LOG.md.

action.prompt:
The agent run has stopped. Do a quick compliance pass, following the #health-safety steering rules:

1. Identify the files changed during this session (use `git status --porcelain` and `git diff` to see staged, unstaged, and newly created files).

2. Scan the content of those changed files for:
   - Forbidden claim terms (case-insensitive): "neglected", "underfunded", "needs more trials". These framing/claim words violate the "index, not prediction/recommendation" rule.
   - Contact data: email addresses, phone numbers, and investigator/contact/official names. Per health-safety, these must never be read, stored, logged, or displayed. Do NOT reproduce any matched contact value in your output or in the log — refer to it by file and field only.

3. If you find any forbidden term or contact data, flag it clearly in your response: list the file and the kind of violation (never the raw contact value), and recommend removing it. Do not auto-commit changes that contain violations.

4. Append exactly ONE line to KIRO_LOG.md summarizing this check. Use the existing pipe-delimited row format and a UTC timestamp:
   | <UTC time, e.g. 2026-10-24T18:30Z> | Kiro | Stop hook | <one short sentence: what was checked and whether any forbidden terms or contact data were found> | |

Keep the summary factual and free of any actual contact values.
